AI Call Summarizer

Paste the transcript from Teams, Zoom or Gong, or your meeting captions, into the box. Claude writes a summary, decisions, next steps, your to-dos and a follow-up email from that text. Tell everyone you are taking notes. Nothing is recorded or saved as audio.

    Data notes and caveats (read before acting on scorecard flags)
    • Practice Management data looks stale. The newest PM Last Bill Date in Gainsight is 2026-08-26, about two months before today. Bill-date status is scored against that snapshot date, not today. Against today every account would read At Risk. Check whether the PM feed into Gainsight stopped.
    • Clariti Last Login is probably a batch date. About 40 accounts share 2026-08-10 or 2026-08-11. The <3 day / >5 day thresholds can't be applied reliably, so only logins older than 60 days, or no login on record, are flagged.
    • % Cancelled Visits is not scored. The field holds values like 0.1 to 0.3 as text, so the unit is unclear (fraction or percent). Confirm the unit and it can be added. Implant Cost, ERA Files, Case Coordination ratio, eChart task aging and Clariti estimates are not scored yet either.
    • Coverage: every active account, every open CTA on them, and Salesforce cases for every account. Nine records are flagged "Cleanup" because they have $0 ARR or are marked Closed/Churned while still Active. They are kept in the table but not scored. Open cases include any age. Closed-case counts are exact only where six or more closed in 90 days; otherwise they show "<6".
    • Accounts without Practice Management are not scored on bill date.
    • NPS risk uses Gainsight NPS and CSAT on each account (latest score, average of prior individual scores, and survey dates) together with the support case trend. The risk score is a rule of thumb, not a prediction: CSAT 33% or lower in the last 5 months +35, 34 to 67% +22; prior NPS average score 6.5 or lower +25, 7.5 or lower +12; NPS below -20 +15; support cases rising +15; urgent or high case open +15; Red health +10. Gainsight's NPS survey responses themselves were not accessible, so comments are not shown.
    • Support case trend compares Salesforce cases created Jul 29 – Oct 27 with Apr 29 – Jul 28 on your accounts. Issue groups use the Case Reason and Product fields, or the escalation type, because case descriptions are not available. The tags on each account show groups where it has 3 or more cases (2 or more for escalation types), plus how many of your accounts share that issue.
    • Nimble and Serbin: any account whose Salesforce RCM Provider is Nimble (including National Medical Billing Services, NMBS/Nimble, and Nimble (Medtek)) or Serbin Medical Billing is left out of Synergen outbound. Accounts recorded only as "NMBS" are treated as Nimble. Precision Ambulatory lists Nimble as its Anesthesia RCM, a separate field, and is not excluded.
    • Trending questions above the search bar rotate every hour. They come from Salesforce case topics (Case Reason and Product) on your accounts, last 90 days compared with the 90 before, plus how often each Knowledge article is attached to cases. Case emails and descriptions are not available to the dashboard, and the counts are a snapshot, so they update only when the data is refreshed.
    • HST tips come from the published Salesforce Knowledge articles. The two how-to tips use the article text. The rest point to articles and webinars by title and summary only, so check the article before sharing it with a customer.
    • CSQL is calculated from Salesforce opportunities whose Primary Campaign Source is Client Success - CSQL 2026, where you are the Client Success Manager (55 opportunities, 53 of them created in 2026; the campaign holds 322 across all CSMs). It uses Net ARR and the quarter each opportunity was created. The $93K quota is treated as quarterly. Synergen leads come from the separate Client Success - Synergen CSQL 2026 campaign and are not counted. Outreach uses calls, meetings and emails logged on the Gainsight timeline; many accounts share contact dates of Oct 19–22, which looks like a bulk sync.
    • Stale opportunities are open Stage 0–4 opps with ARR above $0 and no activity or update since before Sept 15, found by the Client Success Manager field and by account. Opps with $0 ARR were not included.
    • Synergen contract end dates are excluded from Renewals because that team manages those renewals.
    • Contract end dates are not lapse dates. Most Salesforce contracts carry an expiration of 2049-12-31, which suggests evergreen or auto-renew terms. Past-dated rows mean "confirm status," not "lost." Ironclad is the next place to verify.
    • No dedicated renewal report was found in Gainsight (the closest was a Finance_Approved_Opportunities layout), so renewals here come from Salesforce opportunities where you are the Client Success Manager.
    • Gong coverage: four accounts were read for the last 90 days. Summaries are Gong's own synthesis, with call links where Gong returned them. Items in [brackets] in draft emails are placeholders to confirm before sending.
    • Colors: red, amber and green are used only as status signals. Everything else follows the HST palette.
    Internal Use Only · The page reloads itself at 6 AM, 12 PM and 4 PM Pacific while it is open · Sources: Gainsight · Salesforce · Gong · Scorecard Metrics document. Nothing in this dashboard has been written back to any system.
